changes.reason: Changed-test observations count executed test records and distinguish them from skipped results and suite metadata. Incomplete runs do not count toward enforcement.

kubernetes.reason: The changed-test planner evaluates an in-memory test evidence bundle in the local tooling path. It requires no Kubernetes Node Host capability, storage, or lifecycle behavior.

aws-lambda.reason: The changed-test planner evaluates an in-memory test evidence bundle in the local tooling path. It requires no AWS Lambda Host capability, storage, or lifecycle behavior.

cloudflare.reason: The changed-test planner evaluates an in-memory test evidence bundle in the local tooling path. It requires no Cloudflare Workers or Node Container Host capability, storage, or lifecycle behavior.
